symptom: PC1 can ping other hosts in VLAN 10, but PC2 cannot reach PC1 even though both are connected to Switch1.
topology_notes: PC1 is connected to Switch1 Fa0/1 and belongs to VLAN 10. PC2 is connected to Switch1 Fa0/2 and belongs to VLAN 20. No router is configured between the VLANs. Both PCs use 192.168.10.0/24 addressing by mistake if they were intended to be isolated by VLAN only; expected design is VLAN 10 = 192.168.10.0/24 and VLAN 20 = 192.168.20.0/24. For this lab, PC2 is supposed to be in VLAN 20.
show_output:
Switch1# show vlan brief

VLAN Name                             Status    Ports
---- -------------------------------- --------- -------------------------------
1    default                          active    Fa0/3, Fa0/4, Fa0/5, Fa0/6, Fa0/7, Fa0/8
10   STUDENTS                         active    Fa0/1

Switch1# show interfaces fa0/2 switchport
Name: Fa0/2
Switchport: Enabled
Administrative Mode: static access
Operational Mode: static access
Access Mode VLAN: 1 (default)
expected_root_cause: VLAN 20 does not exist, and PC2's access port Fa0/2 remains in VLAN 1 instead of VLAN 20.
expected_fix: Create VLAN 20 and assign Switch1 Fa0/2 as an access port in VLAN 20. Place PC2 in 192.168.20.0/24 if that is the intended subnet.
verification: show vlan brief lists VLAN 20 with Fa0/2; PC2 is in the correct VLAN.

symptom: PC-A in the Sales VLAN cannot communicate with the Sales printer that is connected to Switch1 Fa0/8.
topology_notes: Sales VLAN is VLAN 30. PC-A is on Switch1 Fa0/3 and is correctly in VLAN 30. The Sales printer is on Switch1 Fa0/8 and must also be in VLAN 30. VLAN 30 exists on the switch.
show_output:
Switch1# show vlan brief

VLAN Name                             Status    Ports
---- -------------------------------- --------- -------------------------------
1    default                          active    Fa0/1, Fa0/2, Fa0/4, Fa0/5, Fa0/6, Fa0/7, Fa0/8
30   SALES                            active    Fa0/3

Switch1# show interfaces fa0/8 switchport
Name: Fa0/8
Administrative Mode: static access
Access Mode VLAN: 1 (default)
expected_root_cause: The printer port Fa0/8 is still an access port in VLAN 1 instead of VLAN 30.
expected_fix: Configure Switch1 Fa0/8 as switchport mode access and switchport access vlan 30.
verification: show vlan brief shows Fa0/8 in VLAN 30; PC-A can reach the printer.

symptom: Hosts in VLAN 40 on SwitchA cannot reach hosts in VLAN 40 on SwitchB. Local switching on each switch works.
topology_notes: SwitchA Gi0/1 connects to SwitchB Gi0/1. The link must trunk VLANs 1, 10, 40. VLAN 40 is named VOICE. Both switches have VLAN 40 created locally.
show_output:
SwitchA# show interfaces trunk

Port        Mode         Encapsulation  Status        Native vlan
Gi0/1       on           802.1q         trunking      1

Port        Vlans allowed on trunk
Gi0/1       1,10

Port        Vlans allowed and active in management domain
Gi0/1       1,10

SwitchB# show interfaces trunk

Port        Mode         Encapsulation  Status        Native vlan
Gi0/1       on           802.1q         trunking      1

Port        Vlans allowed on trunk
Gi0/1       1,10,40
expected_root_cause: SwitchA's trunk Gi0/1 does not allow VLAN 40, so VLAN 40 traffic is not forwarded to SwitchB.
expected_fix: On SwitchA, allow VLAN 40 on the Gi0/1 trunk (switchport trunk allowed vlan 1,10,40).
verification: show interfaces trunk on SwitchA lists 40; VLAN 40 hosts across switches can ping.

symptom: After connecting two switches, VLAN 1 management works but VLAN 10 users report intermittent connectivity and unexpected broadcasts.
topology_notes: Switch1 Gi0/1 trunks to Switch2 Gi0/1. Native VLAN should be VLAN 99 on both sides. VLAN 10 is the user VLAN.

Port        Mode         Encapsulation  Status        Native vlan
Gi0/1       on           802.1q         trunking      1

Port        Vlans allowed on trunk
Gi0/1       1,10,99

Port        Mode         Encapsulation  Status        Native vlan

Gi0/1       1,10,99
expected_root_cause: Native VLAN mismatch: Switch1 native VLAN is 1 while Switch2 native VLAN is 99.
expected_fix: Set the native VLAN to 99 on both trunk ends: switchport trunk native vlan 99.
verification: Both trunks show Native vlan 99; VLAN 10 traffic is stable.
